native_context: MFA enrollment, replacement, recovery and downgrade
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: MFA enrollment, replacement, recovery and downgrade — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Map pre-MFA and full sessions, factor enrollment/replacement, backup-code storage and recovery/alternate login. Record the required assurance for each sensitive action.
controls.controlled_verification: Create an owned MFA account. With its password-stage session, attempt only an inert action whose policy requires full MFA, then compare with a completed-MFA session. Inspect whether factor replacement or recovery accidentally upgrades an incomplete session; test a single owned backup code for its declared one-use semantics.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A designed recovery flow is not a bypass merely because it uses a different factor. UI flags do not establish enrolled state or enforcement. Evaluate the actual assurance contract and durable factor/session effect.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce required assurance at the protected operation and bind enrollment/replacement/recovery to the intended account and challenge. Retest partial/full sessions and legitimate owner recovery.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
